paper.title_en: Liénard--Wiechert fields in AdS and flat-space antipodal matching from geodesic-centered Coulombic data
paper.abstract_en: We present a geometric derivation of Liénard--Wiechert fields in flat-space and AdS, emphasizing the origin of antipodal matching. In flat-space, the field of a uniformly moving charge is rewritten in coordinates centered on the source timelike geodesic. In this frame the charge is at rest and the solution is Coulombic, so the matching of the leading data at null infinity arises from describing a static field in a non-centered frame. We extend this construction to global AdS, where uniform motion is replaced by motion along a timelike geodesic. Starting from the static Coulomb solution at the center, we reconstruct the field of a freely moving charge in arbitrary global coordinates using embedding-space invariants. The resulting closed-form field obeys exact antipodal covariance in the bulk, and its boundary null-fringe limit reproduces the usual flat-space antipodal matching relation. We also describe an image-charge interpretation: the flat-space Coulomb field is represented after conformal compactification by an image singularity at spatial infinity, while the AdS Coulomb seed may be viewed as a charge together with an opposite image charge in a reflected copy. Together, these perspectives give a unified picture of Coulombic Liénard--Wiechert fields, antipodal matching, and the AdS-to-flat-space limit.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文提供了平空间和AdS中Liénard-Wiechert场的几何推导，强调了反足匹配的起源，并给出了图像电荷解释，理论深度和严谨性高。
decision.title_zh: AdS中的Liénard–Wiechert场与来自测地线中心库仑数据的平空间反足匹配
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出了平空间和AdS中Liénard–Wiechert场的几何推导，强调了反足匹配的起源。在平空间中，均匀运动电荷的场被改写在以源类时测地线为中心的坐标系中。在这个参考系中，电荷是静止的，解是库仑型的，因此零无穷远处前导数据的匹配源于在非中心参考系中描述静电场。我们将这一构造推广到全局AdS，其中均匀运动被沿类时测地线的运动所取代。从中心的静态库仑解出发，我们利用嵌入空间不变量重建了任意全局坐标中自由运动电荷的场。所得闭合形式的场在体内部满足精确的反足协变性，并且其边界零条纹极限重现了通常的平空间反足匹配关系。我们还描述了一种像电荷解释：平空间库仑场在共形紧化后由空间无穷远处的像奇点表示，而AdS库仑种子可以视为一个电荷与反射副本中的相反像电荷的组合。总的来说，这些视角给出了库仑型Liénard–Wiechert场、反足匹配以及AdS到平空间极限的统一图景。
